oneLiner: Split shared trip expenses with friends in seconds, no spreadsheet required.
problem: Group trips generate messy, scattered expenses across cash, cards, and apps, and manually tracking who owes what in a spreadsheet is tedious, error-prone, and often abandoned mid-trip.
targetUser: Friends, couples, or groups who travel together and need a fast, low-friction way to track and settle shared costs.
coreFlow: Create a trip and add participants
Log an expense, choose who paid and who it's split between
App auto-calculates running balances for each person
View simplified 'who owes who' summary at any time
Mark debts as settled once paid back

screens.name: Trip Dashboard
screens.purpose: Show all active trips with quick balance snapshots

screens.name: Trip Detail
screens.purpose: List all expenses in a trip and current participant balances

screens.name: Add Expense
screens.purpose: Quickly log who paid, amount, and split method

screens.name: Settle Up
screens.purpose: Show simplified debts and let users mark payments as complete

screens.name: Trip Setup
screens.purpose: Create a new trip and invite/add participants

outOfScope: Real payment processing or bank integrations
